title: Mean at the critical probability
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and let $p_c$ denote its critical probability. The critical mean is the bias mean at parameter $p_c$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
